select.rule: Correct (or ungraded chat) and finished answers; within a problem and thinking mode, answers under 1/3 or over 2 times the median length are dropped, the others kept with probability min(1, median/length). Tokens outside the student's 64K vocabulary become its pieces (heal_sessions.StudentTokens).

train.schedule: Warmup over the first 5 steps of all sessions, then constant; heal_sessions.py decay makes a decayed evaluation copy without touching the main state.

evaluation: After each few sessions, a decayed copy is checked sampled (the card's sampler) on the 96 GSM8K check prompts with thinking on and off, against S0_K24_T3M (on 57, off 51) and the dense yardsticks (Qwen3.5-2B off 71, 4B and 9B off 83); a MATH-500 subset and a non-math check are to be added before the first comparison is claimed.

machine_faults.finding: The faults are not the healed copies'. In every faulty eval the dense model's own pass (slim.on False, no LoRA or router of any copy involved) has NLLs that differ from a clean run's, by up to thousands of nats per doc on the 64K path: crashed_check_75_off 36 of 116 docs, crashed_check_75_on 33, crashed2_check_75_off 34, check_75_off (session 2 thinking off) 19; session 1's check_89_on 16 and check_89_off 3. Clean: all six heal_geometry checks (2026-11-03/04), check_0_on and its seed 2, check_75_on and its seed 2, trace_check_75_on, and every repeat_full run. Some processes on this machine compute wrong values; the same process then also produces the non-finite logits and device asserts seen in generation. No package changed since 2026-11-01; the faults start 2026-11-05, the day the GPU began to be shared by several sessions, and the machine hard-hung on 2026-11-05 21:23 and 2026-11-07 02:05.
machine_faults.guard: heal_sessions.dense_canary: every check compares its dense pass with check_0_on's and records faulty_docs and the other GPU processes (gpu_users) in check.json; a check with faulty_docs > 0 is not used.
machine_faults.consequences: Session 2's thinking-off 46/96 is void (rerun at both seeds queued: scripts/after_session3.sh). Session 1's 35/96 thinking on and its eval KL 0.785 came from faulty processes; its router drift (norm 16.7 -> 31.7) is real, the size of its damage is not measured.
machine_faults.sharing_2026_11_07: Session 3's dibs hold on the GPU (dibs run gpu --eta 9h, PID 30054, still running) lost its lock record during the morning: dibs status showed asd-ste100 holding the GPU at 07:53 and the npu-kernel-coder bakeoff from about 13:10, whose Vulkan llama-server (Qwen3.8-27B, -ngl 99) ran beside the faulty checks. gpu_users looked only at /dev/kfd and missed it; it now also lists render-node (Vulkan) users. Every check that shared the GPU this way was faulty; the shard-1 held-out run, the one eval that came out right, has no record of who else was on the GPU. Sharing is the leading suspect, not shown.
machine_faults.quiet_test_2026_11_08: rechecks_quiet.sh started each attempt only after two minutes with no other GPU process: 6 of 6 checks came out clean at the first attempt, both canaries, no non-finite rows. The same checks beside other sessions' GPU jobs (rechecks.sh, 2026-11-07) gave 1 clean in 20. Sharing the GPU between processes causes the wrong values. dibs does not prevent it: it showed the GPU free while rechecks_quiet.sh held it. Rule from here: a local eval counts only if run with no other GPU process and both canaries clean; training logs others_on_gpu at every step.
